caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a woman's dress on a blank background. The dress is shown from the front in the main, larger view and from the back in a smaller inset at the upper right corner. The garment consists of a full, floor-length skirt and a fitted bodice with a wide, flowing shawl or lace covering draped over the shoulders and extending to the hem of the skirt. The shawl is outlined with intricate floral lace patterns along its edges, with additional fine details of flowers and leaves depicted throughout the trim. The dress and shawl are rendered in fine, precise lines in shades of gray and black pencil on a light beige, uncolored background. The composition is clean, with the focus on the clothing details and structure.
